summary: Container apps in the one-click installer: Ghost, Nextcloud, Uptime Kuma, n8n, Gitea, Plausible and Jellyfin, on private networks with loopback-only ports via guarded agent verbs (KD-040). App backup and restore with in-container database dumps; S3 provider presets with a live test (KD-043). App health alerts (KD-042), OS package updates and an in-panel update notice (KD-041). `sudo kaname update` on the server: through the panel when it can, directly (database dump, settings snapshot, auto-rollback) when it cannot, one update at a time, re-attaches after a dropped SSH session, and its runs show in Administration > Updates. A new terminal installer with live progress. Ubuntu: waits for unattended-upgrades, refuses snap Docker, non-interactive needrestart and an apt lock timeout for OS updates. Kaname by FutureForge Studios across the panel and tools. Migrations 0010-0012 are additive: app_port, app health tables, restore_points.manifest.
